name: Open Legal Compliance MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to search and analyze legal documents from multiple jurisdictions including US federal and state law, case law, EU regulations, UK legislation, Canadian law, Congress bills, SEC filings, and FDA data through free government APIs.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to search and analyze legal documents from multiple jurisdictions including US federal and state law, case law, EU regulations, UK legislation, Canadian law, Congress bills, SEC filings, and FDA data through free government APIs.

CANLII_API_KEY.description: Your CanLII API key (optional, enables searching Canadian case law). Obtain from https://www.canlii.org/en/api/

GOVINFO_API_KEY.description: Your GovInfo API key (required for US Code and CFR searches). Obtain from https://api.govinfo.gov/

OPEN_STATES_API_KEY.description: Your Open States API key (optional, enables searching legislation across all 50 US states). Obtain from https://openstates.org/

CONGRESS_GOV_API_KEY.description: Your Congress.gov API key (optional, enables searching US Congress bills and legislation). Obtain from https://api.congress.gov/

COURTLISTENER_API_KEY.description: Your CourtListener API key (optional, enables US case law searches). Obtain from https://www.courtlistener.com/api/

rawRecord.name: Open Legal Compliance MCP Server
